instruction:

Total of cost

Average of cost

instruction:

Maximum cost
output: SELECT MAX(cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Minimum cost
output: SELECT MIN(cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Row count
output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Count distinct values of dept
output: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dept) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Total cost per dept
output: SELECT dept, SUM(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Average cost per dept
output: SELECT dept, AVG(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Maximum cost per dept
output: SELECT dept, MAX(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
dept with total cost above 1000
output: SELECT dept, SUM(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept HAVING SUM(cost) > 1000;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
dept groups having more than 5 records
output: SELECT dept, COUNT(*) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Count records per dept
output: SELECT dept, COUNT(*) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Total cost grouped by dept ordered by total desc
output: SELECT dept, SUM(cost) AS tot FROM expenses GROUP BY dept ORDER BY tot DESC;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Minimum cost per dept
output: SELECT dept, MIN(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Average cost where cost > 0
output: SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expenses WHERE cost > 0;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Total cost for records after 2024
output: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Rollup of dept with totals
output: SELECT dept, SUM(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY ROLLUP(dept);

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Cube of dept with totals
output: SELECT dept, SUM(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY CUBE(dept);

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Standard deviation of cost
output: SELECT STDDEV(cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Variance of cost
output: SELECT VARIANCE(cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Total cost for each dept having at least 2 rows
output: SELECT dept, SUM(cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Median of cost per dept
output: SELECT dept, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Sum and count combined per dept
output: SELECT dept, SUM(cost), COUNT(*) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Grouping by two columns dept and cost
output: SELECT dept, cost, COUNT(*) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept, cost;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(id, dept, cost, posted_date)
Number of distinct posted_date per dept
output: SELECT dept, COUNT(DISTINCT posted_date) FROM expenses GROUP BY dept;
